title: fix(plugin-grid): report a rejected aggregate bulk action as one outcome and refresh the list
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9FjkKnUT9gkJCgXLZMd3GkS)_

Fixes #34173

Clause-②: yes (widening) — optional member userMessage on ActionResult (@object-ui/types) and ActionResponseOutcome (@object-ui/core); nothing removed or renamed
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：选择栏里「整体执行」（`execution: 'aggregate'`）的批量动作被拒时，结果框只说一次「操作未对所选记录全部完成」，并只显示一次处理器写给用户的提示（`userMessage`，没有就用 `message`）；不再逐行重复同一句报错，也不再显示「成功 0 / N」。关掉结果框后列表会重新读取，被改过的记录显示新值。逐条执行的批量动作显示完全不变。
- **为什么改**：HotCRM 实测：选两个商机批量改阶段，一个已赢单被拒、另一个其实改了，结果框却说 0/2、每行都是平台报错，列表也不刷新，销售看不出哪条动了。
- **风险与回滚**：只影响 aggregate 批量动作的结果框和关闭后的刷新；`ActionResult`（`@object-ui/types`）和 `ActionResponseOutcome`（`@object-ui/core`）各多一个可选字段 `userMessage`。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/hooks/useBulkExecutor.ts`（aggregate 一次结算、一个结果）；`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/BulkActionDialog.tsx`（结果框的 aggregate 分支）；`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`（拒绝时带上 `userMessage`、关闭时刷新）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/objectBulkActionDispatch.test.tsx`，预期全绿，其中 `an aggregate rejection is one outcome for the selection` 组 5 条。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

A rejected aggregate bulk run is ONE outcome for the selection. The one call cannot say which rows it wrote before it stopped (a non-transactional body can move some rows and then reject once), so the result no longer pretends to a per-row count.

- `useBulkExecutor`: an `execution: 'aggregate'` def no longer rides the bulk-first decision tree. It makes its one `runAggregate` call; resolved, every row counts as covered (unchanged); rejected, the result carries `aggregateRejection: { message }`, where `message` is `declaredUserMessage(error)` (the producer-marked `userMessage`) else the error's own message, and `errors` gets no per-row entry. A rejected run also invalidates the resource's cached related counts, as a successful one does. `BulkResult` is not exported from the package.
- `BulkActionDialog`: for a result with `aggregateRejection`, the panel says the action did not complete for the selected records (new key `grid.bulk.aggregateNotCompleted`) and shows the message once. No "Succeeded x / N", no per-row list, no error CSV, no Retry. Every other result renders exactly as before.
- `ObjectGrid`: the aggregate dispatcher rejects with an `Error` whose `message` is `ActionResult.error` and which carries `ActionResult.userMessage` when present. On dialog close, a result with `aggregateRejection` bumps `refreshKey`, the same refresh path the per-row run already takes when rows succeeded; the selection stays, ready for a re-run. A resolved aggregate run keeps its existing refresh, which happens once.
- The carrier: `interpretActionResponse` reads the refusal's `error.userMessage` (ADR-0112 envelope; non-empty string only, verbatim) onto `ActionResponseOutcome.userMessage`, and `createServerActionHandler` relays it on the failed `ActionResult.userMessage`. `error` stays the whole text, so every existing reader of `error` (toasts, the per-row list) is unchanged. The reader `refusalUserMessage` stays off the package's public entry.
- i18n: `grid.bulk.aggregateNotCompleted` in all eleven packs (`zh-Hant` regenerated with `gen-zh-hant.mjs`). The sentence has no `{{count}}`, so it is not a plural family.
- Docs: `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` says what the dialog shows for a rejected aggregate run and when the list re-reads.

## Tests

- `objectBulkActionDispatch.test.tsx`, new top-level describe `an aggregate rejection is one outcome for the selection (objectstack#34173)`, driven through the real `script` dispatch (`createServerActionHandler`) and the `/actions` door's refusal envelope:
  - the rejection's `userMessage` shows once; the platform `message` is absent; zero `bulk-error-row-*`; no "Succeeded" and no "0 / 2" text;
  - with no `userMessage`, the `message` shows once;
  - the grid's `find` runs exactly once after Done following a rejection, and exactly once following a resolve;
  - CONTROL: a per-record dispatch (`bulkActions: ['mass_update_stage']`) with one refused row still reads "Succeeded 1 / 2" and lists `bulk-error-row-r2` with the row's error text.
- `useBulkExecutor.test.ts`: a rejection is one `aggregateRejection` with `errors: []`; it reports `userMessage` over `message`; a resolved call carries no rejection.
- `serverActionHandler.test.ts`, new describe `userMessage relay`: relayed verbatim beside `error`; absent when unmarked; a blank, numeric or object value is no marking.
- **Forced test edits** (each pinned the behaviour this card calls the defect):
  - `useBulkExecutor.test.ts` "attributes a failed aggregate call to every id with the real error — no per-record re-dispatch" is now "a failed aggregate call is one outcome for the selection — no per-id error, no per-record re-dispatch".
  - `useBulkExecutor.test.ts` "fails loudly when no runAggregate is wired…" now reads the message from `aggregateRejection` instead of `errors[0]`.
  - `objectBulkActionDispatch.test.tsx` "attributes a failed aggregate call to every record, with no per-row Retry" is now "reports a failed aggregate call once for the selection, with no per-row list and no Retry".

## Acceptance notes

- **File surface beyond the claim, declared:** `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` (the dialog's mount, and the per-row refresh path the order says to reuse lives there); `ui/packages/types/src/ui-action.ts` (`ActionResult.userMessage`, the carrier from the script dispatch to the grid); `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` (ui commandment 2, docs-driven); all eleven locale packs, because `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts` requires every pack to define every `en` key, so "let other locales fall back" is not available in this pack.
- **Public face for the seat to judge:** two optional members on published types, `ActionResult.userMessage` (`@object-ui/types`) and `ActionResponseOutcome.userMessage` (`@object-ui/core`). No new exported name. Precedent: `ActionResult.fieldErrors`, the same relay of the same refusal envelope. The seat ruled the declaration `Clause-②: yes (widening)` (a non-protocol widening, so the changeset stays `patch`); the PR body and the changeset carry it since head 3f829b53.
- **Card ask 3 (a per-row result shape for aggregate handlers) is still needed** for a truthful per-row count: with this PR the dialog no longer states a false count, but it still cannot say which rows moved. That is an action-contract change in `packages/spec`, out of scope here.
- **Same class, left unchanged as ordered:** a per-record bulk row refused with a `userMessage` still lists the row's `error` (the platform message), and the single-record action toast reads `error` too. With `ActionResult.userMessage` now carried, preferring it there is a small follow-up. The CONTROL pin above shows the current per-row text.
- The list re-reads when the dialog closes (the path the per-row run uses), not at the instant the call settles; the dialog is modal over the grid.
- Out of scope, as the card says: a script action body gets no locale in `ctx.session` (the #34062 class).

## Verification

<details><summary>Measured on main 75ab1178 before the fix: all three symptoms, script dispatch</summary>

A probe test drove the real `ObjectGrid` with `createServerActionHandler`; the `/actions` answer was `400 { success: false, error: { code: 'HOOK_ABORTED', message: 'mass_update_stage: Plan B is Closed Won', userMessage: 'Plan B is Closed Won and was not moved.' } }`:

```text
PROBE[reject] dialog text: "Update StageSucceeded 0 / 2 · Failed 2 … Plan A: mass_update_stage: Plan B is Closed WonPlan B: mass_update_stage: Plan B is Closed Won Download error CSV Done"
PROBE[reject] actions POSTs: 1 error rows: 2
PROBE[reject] find calls on Done: 0
PROBE[resolve] dialog text: "Update StageSucceeded 2 / 2 … • Plan A• Plan B Done"
PROBE[resolve] find calls on Done: 1
```

The wire for both handler shapes, read from `actionsDoorAnswerOf` (`@objectstack/types` dist on the same tree): a script body's sandboxed throw and a server action's plain throw both answer `userMessage` beside `message`:

```text
script-body    {"status":400,"code":"HOOK_ABORTED","message":"Plan B is Closed Won","userMessage":"Plan B is Closed Won and was not moved."}
server-handler {"status":400,"code":"VALIDATION_ERROR","message":"Plan B is Closed Won","userMessage":"Plan B is Closed Won and was not moved."}
```

The client then dropped `userMessage` in `interpretActionResponse` / `actionErrorDetail`, which read `error.message` only.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: five legs, each red, restored clean (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, anchors hit 1 → 0)</summary>

Committed fix first (7cf6c654); each leg mutated one line and ran the three touched test files; the trap restored `git checkout HEAD -- ui/packages` and printed `RESTORED-CLEAN`. Tests resolve `@object-ui/*` from source, so no dist rebuild was involved.

- `useBulkExecutor.ts` `declaredUserMessage(e)` → `null`: red "shows the rejection's userMessage once…" and "the rejection reports its producer-marked userMessage, not its message".
- `ObjectGrid.tsx` the rejection refresh branch disabled: red "re-reads the grid once when the dialog closes after a rejection".
- `BulkActionDialog.tsx` per-row branch guard removed (`!result.aggregateRejection`): red "shows the rejection's userMessage once, with no per-row list and no "0 / N" count".
- `serverActionHandler.ts` `userMessage` relay removed: red "relays error.userMessage verbatim…" and the dialog userMessage pin.
- `useBulkExecutor.ts` aggregate branch disabled: red across both aggregate describes (11 tests).
</details>

<details><summary>Local runs on head 2ee839f6 (main 571cf908 merged)</summary>

Head 3f829b53 changes only the changeset's Clause-② line; on it `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-adr-0087-registration` (each `--base origin/main`), `check:changeset-gate-self-tests` and `check:nul-bytes` re-ran, exit 0 each.

- Type-check (`pnpm run type-check`, tsc echoed): `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid` — each exit 0.
- Whole packages: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/ packages/types/ packages/i18n/ packages/core/src/actions/` — Test Files 830 passed (830), Tests 15603 passed, 13 skipped. Lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Wider readers, narrowed by grep for the changed symbols and testids under `ui/packages` and `ui/apps` (declared narrowing; CI's Test UI runs everything): 12 files in components, app-shell and console — Test Files 12 passed, Tests 466 passed.
- `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys` (ui): exit 0 each.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 72 derived families, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 72 derived, 72 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Dogfood battery: not run — no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.
</details>
